One explanation is that stacking hedges diluted the signal: in earlier worlds, single layouts scored 0.8–0.9 where their 4-layout sets scored only 0.15–0.25. Another is that the deviation is not a frame mismatch at all. This is the last round, so I am testing undiluted nets with no layout hedge. Feeding the obs under all 8 symmetries, with the identity action reading, covers every relative orientation of obs and actions using one layout. I try this type-major, type-minor, and type-major with higher entropy, in case the policy collapses to DONE. Three single layouts without obs symmetries test the precedent frames directly: transpose (world 2), x-flip (world 6) and y-flip (world 7).
